title: CoLU: Confidence-Weighted Layerwise Unlearning for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.22721v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) unlearning aims to forget certain information while preserving others, without retraining from scratch. SoTA methods such as NPO, SimNPO, and SatImp balance forgetting and retain through whole model fine-tuning, while FOM-UL explores selective layer updates. Prior works show that suppressing target information can damage retained knowledge. This trade-off can vary across layers even under the same unlearning loss. In this work, we propose Confidence-Weighted Layerwise Unlearning (CoLU), which combines a novel confidence-weighted forgetting and retain regularization while updating a single selected transformer layer, rather than the whole model for unlearning. To reduce CoLU compute cost, we further propose Brief Layer Screening (BLS), which uses a newly defined normalized forgetting-retention (NFR) score to first rank layers through a brief unlearning trials using a subset of forgetting dataset and fewer epochs

translated_title: CoLU：面向大语言模型的置信度加权逐层遗忘方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）遗忘旨在让模型遗忘特定信息的同时保留其他信息，而无需从头重新训练。当前最先进的方法如NPO、SimNPO和SatImp通过全模型微调来平衡遗忘与保留，而FOM-UL则探索了选择性层更新策略。先前的研究表明，抑制目标信息可能会损害被保留的知识，并且即使使用相同的遗忘损失，这种权衡在不同层之间也存在差异。在本工作中，我们提出了置信度加权逐层遗忘方法，该方法将一种新颖的置信度加权遗忘与保留正则化相结合，仅更新单个选定的Transformer层，而非对整个模型进行遗忘。为了降低CoLU的计算成本，我们进一步提出了简短层筛选，该方法利用新定义的归一化遗忘-保留分数，通过在遗忘数据集的一个子集上以更少的训练轮次进行简短的遗忘试验来对各个层进行排序。
tldr: 该论文提出CoLU方法，通过置信度加权的遗忘与保留正则化仅更新单个选定的Transformer层来实现大语言模型遗忘，并配合基于归一化遗忘-保留分数的简短层筛选策略高效选取最优层，在降低计算成本的同时更好地平衡了遗忘效果与知识保留。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CoLU, which achieves LLM unlearning by updating only a single selected Transformer layer with confidence-weighted forgetting and retention regularization, and introduces Brief Layer Screening (BLS) that efficiently ranks layers using a normalized forgetting-retention score, balancing unlearning and knowledge retention at reduced computational cost.
